text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Eishin Flash looking somewhat 
gloomy.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I searched for ingredients to cook a dish 
I used to eat a lot back home, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Caviar is really expensive in Japan, isn't 
it...? There's no way I could afford it 
with my allowance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't bring myself to say, "I'll buy 
it for you"... Eishin Flash walked away 
looking crestfallen...
